data.one_liner: Build and test Flutter widgets in isolation.
data.what_it_does: Monarch is a tool for building Flutter widgets in isolation. It enables developers to write stories to preview widgets, test edge cases, and debug UI components without running the entire application or emulator.
use_when: You want to build and test complex Flutter widgets in isolation
You want to preview UI components across multiple devices, themes, and localizations without launching the full app
avoid_when: You are building a backend-focused application with minimal UI components
You do not wish to adopt a storybook-style workflow for your widget development
strengths: Enables visual debugging and hot reload for individual widgets
Allows reusing stories in widget tests
weaknesses: Requires code generation and external setup steps
Adds an additional tool and workflow to manage alongside standard Flutter development
data.setup_notes: Requires code generation using build_runner and setting up Monarch tool workflows.

alternatives.name: widgetbook
alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative tool for organizing and developing Flutter widgets in isolation similar to Storybook.
